title: Dashboard docs are easier to find and share
summary:
Dashboard docs became easier to copy, while two community image tools joined the app catalog.

Dashboard cards gained a Docs control that opens the relevant guide or copies it as plain text for an AI chat. The Keys card selects docs based on key type and now shows a copyable CLI command for app keys.

Community contributor @Deheroesytumbas added Susurros de Buda, a Spanish-language Python CLI for making consistent storybook illustrations from scenes. It supports square and vertical formats, plus configurable style, model, and seed.

Community contributor @baimoyan2005 added Pollen Canvas to the image app catalog. It generates images from text prompts with style and seed controls, and lets people download the results.

daily.title: Copy docs from dashboard cards
daily.text: Open the relevant guide from a dashboard card, or copy its text into an AI chat. The Keys card picks docs for your key type.
